name: @openclinxr/station-mouth-objective
purpose: Shared mouth-station objective: pure lip-seat measures, gate thresholds and solver port types.

exportSummaries.DY_GATE_BIAS_PX: Ground-truth dy gate: absolute signed bias bound, capture-crop px.
exportSummaries.DY_GATE_DETRENDED_MEDIAN_PX: Ground-truth dy gate: detrended tracking-shape median bound, capture-crop px.
exportSummaries.DY_GATE_MAX_PX: Ground-truth dy gate: blowout bound on max absolute error, capture-crop px.
exportSummaries.PENETRATION_FRAMES_MAX: Penetration gate: frames allowed with penetrating verts.
exportSummaries.Problem: Solver input: the unseated asset and the cue track it must satisfy.
exportSummaries.RIM_BAND_MM: Rim-gap gate half-width around the target, mm.
exportSummaries.Solution: Solver output: scored frames plus the provenance the receipt records.
exportSummaries.SolutionFrame: Per-frame scored geometry, head-local mm; deep-comparable for the verifier re-run.
exportSummaries.SolverModule: Pinned solver plug-in: one constant with an id, a version and a pure solve.
exportSummaries.UPPER_DISPLACEMENT_BOUND_MM: Upper-arch silence bound: max head-local displacement on any viseme, mm.
exportSummaries.countPenetratingVerts: Lower front-shell verts at or in front of the lip landmark's max head-local +Z.
exportSummaries.meanRimGapMm: Mean head-local 3D distance from each lower-shell vertex to its nearest inner-rim vertex, mm.
exportSummaries.upperDisplacementMm: Upper front-shell centroid displacement from rest, head-local mm.
